question: Does the default (A19 profile v28) score higher when a bot seat's deep-fit budget is 4,000 rollout turns instead of 2,800, with the same 4,000 ms think deadline, through the production a19-deep-fit-v1 driver?
origin: Owner, 2026-11-21: "4s is fine" (per AI move); confirmation M shipped the deep fit at 2,800 turns as "about 4 s on the 2-vCPU host". Live since the v23 deploy, 2,800 turns take at most about 2.7 s on staging (testapi, AMD EPYC-Rome, two owner games, 62 decisions: p50 ~930 ms, p90 ~2.1 s, max 2.4 / 2.7 s) and 3.3 s on prod (gameapi, Intel Skylake, 40 decisions); offline the Mac does 3.4 turns/ms per process against about 1.0-1.3 on staging and 0.85-1.0 on prod. 4,000 turns re-calibrates the turn budget to the approved 4 s on staging; the driver keeps stopping the deep search at 4,000 ms from the decision start, so a slower host plays the stock choice there, as it does today for an overrun.

candidate.driver: production a19-deep-fit-v1 (v0_8_a19_deep_fit.ts, byte-identical in v28 and prod18) with rolloutTurnBudget 4000 instead of 2800 (research override HOC_RESEARCH_DEEP_FIT_TURNS=4000); predictedDeepToStockRatio 4.07, deep budget R8/S10/M16 and thinkMs 4000 unchanged: the stock search first, the deep search started when stock turns x 5.07 <= 4,000, limited to 4,000 - stock turns, played when it completed, otherwise the stock choice
candidate.seam: entrant seat only: HOC_RESEARCH_ENTRANT_PROD_DEEP_FIT=1 in prod28 ranked_adapter.ts (the production createBotSeatSearchDriver with deepFit, as a live bot seat); the other seat keeps the stock driver (as M); deterministic work mode (turn budgets, no deadlines)
candidate.parity: prod28 with the seams unset == prod28ctl (pristine v28) 2/2 digests; prod28 control (spec am-prod-prod) == prod28 control under spec v19 2/2 on smoke tasks; prod18c/prod18d research copies == prod18b 24/24 and 8/8 digests

control: HOC_RESEARCH_ENTRANT_PROD_DEEP_FIT=1 on prod28 with the shipped budget (2,800 turns).
why: Development budget curve on 1,206 v28 dev drafts (prod18b, spec v19; out/bc-analysis.txt): production deep fit vs stock +3.07 (95% +0.91..+5.21); 5,600 turns vs 2,800 +2.40 (+0.17..+4.67), deep played 79.2% -> 99.7%; arena-like R16 / 8,000 turns +3.40 (+1.37..+5.49). A middle R4/S10/M16 level inside 2,800 turns was flat (out/ad-analysis.txt: -0.33, -2.32..+1.67): the gain needs the full deep search on the big boards. Per-decision calibration (out/cal/cal-d28-own.decisions.jsonl): played 72%, overran 12% (stock 400-599 turns), skipped 16% (stock > 552). 4,000 turns admits stock <= 789 turns.

populations.mirror: cfDP mirror drafts: the entrant and the opponent draft as the v28 default (MG:mix:0.5:2, RUSH_T2=h1 RUSH_T2_MAP=A)
populations.own: cfDP own drafts: the opponent drafts owner-shaped strikers (S:B23:fast:K14)
populations.native: cfDP native drafts: the opponent drafts natively (shooter armies); maps 1 and 3 only

bank.namespace: decoy-path-20261123-v1 (allocate_v39, seeds22; audited at allocation, 0 intersections)
bank.provenance: drafted at 04:20 PST for confirmation DP (build_dp.py), which was never registered; no task of these banks was played on any host (checked before registration). U plays every task: all can change.
bank.design: one draft root per family; mirror and own: families 0-174, maps 1/3/4, 3 fights each; native: families 0-799, maps 1 and 3, 3 fights each (split by family into A 0-399 and B 400-799 for two hosts)

arms.runner: life-pool8.sh / life-run8.ts, spec specs2/am-prod-prod.json (no setup overrides: v28 setup on both seats)
arms.hosts: Mac M4 Max (14 processes: mirror and own, both arms side by side, 6 control + 8 candidate); x3d 9800X3D (12 processes at nice 19, autogroup 19, shared with a peer's job: native A, 5 control + 7 candidate); basenode Ryzen 9 3900X (22 processes: native B, 9 control + 13 candidate; then the 30 G5 mirror tasks, candidate arm). Bun 1.4.5 on all hosts; tree manifests checked equal before launch.

primaryEndpoint: Mean over all 7,950 paired tasks (mirror 1,575 + own 1,575 + native 4,800) of candidate minus control entrant score, in points. 95% percentile interval from 20,000 bootstrap resamples of draft-root family numbers drawn jointly across populations, seed 20261123 (confirm_u_analyze.py).

gates.U1: Lower bound of the primary interval above zero.
gates.U2: Each population (mirror, own, native): estimate at least -2 points.
gates.U3: Each map (1, 3, 4), pooled over populations: estimate at least -2 points.
gates.U4: Candidate games with a quality error at most control games with one + 2.
gates.U5: The 30 tasks of bank/cfU-g5.json, candidate arm, replayed on a second host reproduce the main candidate digests.

cost: Recorded, not gated: deep-fit statistics per arm (decisions, attempted, played, overran) and CPU per game per population. After an adoption: live search_timing on staging and prod (p50 / p90 / max, deep-fit counts).
adoptionRule: If U1-U5 pass, a19-deep-fit at 4,000 rollout turns becomes the next profile under the standing instruction (thinkMs stays 4,000, the owner-approved budget). A failed gate stays recorded as failed: not waived, re-run or relabelled.
notClaimed: A win rate against people; a longer think than 4 s; anything about the x3d arena or tournament tiers; live latency beyond the existing deadline.
